text: My bicycle's in a drift on the west road. Two days to Christmas and I still have a sack full of parcels.
Something walked up and down the hall all afternoon. Up and down. It never knocked.
Me? With this? ...All right. All right! Point it at them and pull. I can do that.
Oh thank God, thank God, real people! I'm Ida, I bring the post from Sankt Anna... I hid under the bed. I'm sorry. I didn't help anyone.
It's so cold. Is the window open? ...Close the window.
I'm bleeding... I'm bleeding all over Frau Vogt's floor...
One at the window! I got it... I think I got it!
Ah! Warn me before you do that!
No, no, no, get away from me!
